metadataReview.note: Reviewed historical date: the City of Bad Mergentheim and the State Office for Heritage explicitly date the Battle of Herbsthausen (Mergentheim) to 5 May 1645. This corrects the source-derived 2 May date at day precision. It is a historical date correction, not a calendar conversion; the CDB90 row dated 2 May remains excluded.
